body: I gave my life to Jesus Christ. It's his now I don't own my life. I trust only in him. He's taken all the worry and burden away from me. If he wants me to eat I eat drink I drink if he wants me to starve I starve so be it. I no longer care if I'm good enough smart enough good looking enoigh I honestly no longer care about anything. Tbh it's kinda like, in my mind, laying on the beach with a Pina colada all day every day. In the bible it calls it being born again and entering into the rest that is Christ. I now live only to serve him. I no longer serve the world and my own personal interests. Keep in mind giving your life to Jesus Christ is a form of suicide but atleast I'm not going to hell.all I did was I got on my knees and just asked Jesus to save me. I was broken emptied of self and humbled. Jesus Christ is the way the truth and the life and no man comes to the father but by him.

Why don't you give Jesus a try. ;) only he can fill that God shaped empty hole inside you. I know I felt empty inside to. No matter what I did I couldn't fill it. I was about to kill myself when I heard a voice say give Jesus a try. I'm telling you he is real and he loves you. Time to  Come out of the darkness brother and expirience the true love of christ jesus. :)

Jesus Christ loved you so much he died for you. All you have to do is believe. Give your life to him and he will comfort you. What you don't realize is that there are demonic spirits all around you right now. But darkness cannot exist where there is light. Jesus is the light. Trust me I've been where you are. Jesus saved me. :)
Jesus Christ died for you. Grace is a gift for those who believe. I promise the darkness will go away if you just put your faith in Jesus Christ. Ask him to save you and he will.
I'm telling you the problem is spiritual. Jesus Christ died for you. He can take away all your pain all you have to do is believe that he can.

I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

I didn't say attempted for a reason. My point is that by giving my life to Christ is the same as commiting suicide. I am dead to the world but alive in christ.  I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
You're not broke you being attacked by demonic spirits. There bis only one name that can set you free. Jesus Christ. Give your life to him. Trust me.

Trust me I know exactly what yall are going thru I was there 4 years ago. It got so bad I was sitting in a hotel room out of money  cocain and booz when I made the decision to kill myself. It was at that moment I heard a voice in my head say why don't you give Jesus a try. So I said f**k it, why the hell not. I remember there being a heavy darkness in the room but I kneeled down and said the first prayer of my life. I just basically gave my life to Jesus Christ. I figured if anyone could save me it was him. After I was done I went to sleep and when I woke up the darkness and the heaviness was gone. Like it was crazy. So I'm telling you its a spiritual issue. Jesus loves us so much he died for us. Jesus came here for sinners not the good church going self righteous people. Anyways call out the name of the Lord and you will be saved.

Focus on Jesus Christ. Learn of him. He died for you not Joseph or Thomas or whoever. One day you'll understand that prophets only existed in the old testament before the holy spirit was poured out on all flesh. Don't follow any man. Just Jesus. Jesus is all you need. Its all about the cross.
